name: TAIWAN

flag.title: Republic of China
flag.note: Red field, blue canton, white sun of 12 rays

lead: Taiwan is a green island off the coast of China. Portuguese sailors named it Formosa in 1542. That means beautiful island. Mountains cover half of it. Taiwan invented bubble tea, a milk tea with chewy tapioca balls.

sections.wows: 7 things to make you go wow

geo: Taiwan has about 1,000 small earthquakes a year. It sits on the Ring of Fire, a belt of quakes and volcanoes. Nearly 200 mountain peaks top 3,000 m.
Taroko Gorge cuts through the eastern mountains. Its turquoise river carved marble walls 1,000 m high.
animals: The Formosan black bear has a yellow V on its chest. Locals call it the moon bear. In the misty peaks, the Mikado pheasant shimmers blue and purple.
Every winter, millions of purple crow butterflies shelter in Maolin valley. It looks like a purple blizzard.
culture: Night markets are Taiwan's living rooms. People eat stinky tofu, oyster omelettes, and mango shaved ice. Bubble tea was invented in Taichung in the 1980s.
Each February, thousands of sky lanterns float over the town of Pingxi. People write wishes on them. Over 15,000 temples dot the island, more per square kilometre than almost anywhere.
history: Austronesian peoples, the island's first people, settled Taiwan at least 6,000 years ago. Dutch traders arrived in 1624. Japan ruled from 1895 to 1945 and built railways and schools.
China's Nationalist government lost a civil war and fled the mainland to Taiwan in 1949. A farming island became a tech giant. Today it makes about 90% of the world's most advanced chips.
wows: Taiwan's TSMC company makes about 90% of the world's most advanced computer chips.
Bubble tea was invented in Taichung in the 1980s.
Taipei's metro trains run on time over 99.7% of the time, among the world's best.
Taiwan has one convenience store for every 1,700 people, more per person than almost anywhere.
Yushan, or Jade Mountain, is nearly 180 m taller than Japan's Mount Fuji.
Taroko Gorge is one of Earth's largest marble canyons.
So many sky lanterns fly at the Lantern Festival that the sky turns orange.

myths.fact: A banana plant is a giant herb (a soft-stemmed plant), not a tree. Its trunk is not wood but tightly rolled leaves.

myths.myth: Taiwan and Thailand are the same place
myths.fact: They are far apart. Taiwan is an island near China. Thailand is on mainland Southeast Asia.
